variety_description: A medium maturity, medium-tall, medium slender aromatic variety, released in 2014 by RRS, Hyderabad for irrigated lowland belt of south India. With medium amylose content and good yield, this variety has secured a place in aromatic rice regions of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana and is being increasingly grown in Bihar, Chattisgarh, and Madhya Pradesh. Tolerant to major diseases, BPH and lodging
